name: Selecting 2 individual files via checkbox (partial selection) drives the header checkbox indeterminate and deletes only those files
description:
Checking 2 file checkboxes (partial selection) drives the header
        'select all' checkbox into the INDETERMINATE state, leaves sibling
        folder checkboxes unchecked, and deleting via the toolbar removes
        only the 2 selected files — subfolders completely unaffected.

        Own fresh `artifact_bucket` instance (function-scoped fixture) —
        deliberately NOT sharing state with `test_delete_subfolder_via_checkbox`
        above, since that test's own core assertion (a1 gets deleted) directly
        conflicts with this test's own precondition (a1 must survive).
descriptionHtml:
Checking 2 file checkboxes (partial selection) drives the header
'select all' checkbox into the INDETERMINATE state, leaves sibling
folder checkboxes unchecked, and deleting via the toolbar removes
only the 2 selected files — subfolders completely unaffected.

    Own fresh `artifact_bucket` instance (function-scoped fixture) —
    deliberately NOT sharing state with `test_delete_subfolder_via_checkbox`
    above, since that test's own core assertion (a1 gets deleted) directly
    conflicts with this test's own precondition (a1 must survive).

steps.name: Step 1 — Navigate to the bucket; verify all 4 top-level items (a1, folder-a, sample - Copy.md, sample.md) are listed
Step 2 — Click the checkbox for 'sample - Copy.md'; verify it becomes checked
Step 3 — Click the checkbox for 'sample.md'; verify it becomes checked
Step 4 — Verify subfolders 'a1' and 'folder-a' remain unchecked (query every visible row independently)
Step 5 — Verify the header 'select all' checkbox shows the INDETERMINATE state (2 of 4 rows selected — neither fully checked nor fully unchecked)
Step 6 — Verify the toolbar delete icon's tooltip reads 'Delete selected files' (2 of 4 rows selected, not all)
Step 7 — Click the toolbar delete icon; verify the delete-confirmation modal opens

Step 8 — Verify the modal's heading is 'Delete confirmation' and its message is the LIVE text 'Are you sure to delete the selected files?' (CLARIFICATION #659, already filed by ELITEA-1847 for this shared component; reverse-masking guard: assert the product's live contract, not the stale case wording)
Step 9 — Click 'Delete'; verify exactly one DELETE request fires whose fname[] params are the 2 literal selected file keys (not a folder-expanded list)
Step 11 — Verify the success toast shows the LIVE text 'The selected files have been successfully deleted.' (CLARIFICATION #660, already filed by ELITEA-1847 for this shared component)
Step 12 — Verify 'sample - Copy.md' and 'sample.md' are no longer listed; only a1/folder-a remain
Step 13 — Verify 'sample - Copy.md' and 'sample.md' are no longer shown in the left-panel tree
Step 14 — Verify, via an INDEPENDENT ground truth beyond the DOM, that a1/folder-a and their own underlying files are completely unaffected
Step 15 — Verify pagination updates to '1 - 2 of 2'
Side-channel check — no console errors across the whole multi-file partial-selection delete flow
